ranking_rule: rank by win pct (ties: point differential, then abbr) from the verified results feed; deterministic and pre-registered
rating_rule: margin-model club effect refit on verified finals through each week (scripts/x3_signals.py fit_all, default lambda 2.0, the published fallback when nested selection is unavailable)
availability_note: Availability change is computable only where consecutive weekly injury-report snapshots exist in the repository (weeks 8-10). Weeks 1-7 have no stored snapshot, so those cells are blank and flagged rather than inferred.
